The WebAssembly JavaScript API (src/page/webassembly.odin, the objects: native/js/odin/web_wasm.odin): a page's own WebAssembly modules, compiled and run by Wasmtime beside the engine's. Off until it is complete (javascript.webassembly.enabled): a page that finds a WebAssembly object expects all of it.

What a page makes (memories, tables, globals, functions, instances) lives in one store per realm, known by numbers. A call that can fail gives a number >= 0 or the opposite of a failure (1 LinkError, 2 RuntimeError, 3 RangeError, 4 TypeError, 5 a WebAssembly exception), the message from WebAssembly_lastError. A value crosses as a cell: an i64 holding an i32, an i64, the bits of a float, a function's number + 1, or an externref's number (0: a null reference).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webassembly.widl.

Odin: import "wren:webassembly".
